name: Party Type 35 Code
definition: Identification of the type of entity involved in a transaction.

OPOI.name: Originating POI
OPOI.definition: Point Of Interaction initiating the card payment transaction.

MERC.name: Merchant
MERC.definition: Merchant providing goods and service in the card payment transaction.

ACCP.name: Acceptor
ACCP.definition: Card acceptor, party accepting the card and presenting transaction data to the acquirer.

ITAG.name: Intermediary Agent
ITAG.definition: Party acting on behalf of other parties to process or forward data to other parties.

DLIS.name: Delegate Issuer
DLIS.definition: Party to whom the card issuer delegates to authorise card payment transactions.

MKTP.name: Marketplace
MKTP.definition: Marketplace providing payment acceptance services on behalf of a merchant.

PFAC.name: Payment Facilitator
PFAC.definition: Payment facilitator providing payment acceptance services on behalf of a merchant.
